title: Street width and design
text:
19.15.110 Street width and design.
Pavement widths and designs of right of way shall comply with the City of El Paso Street Design Manual.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008; Ord. No. 17257, § 1, 12-22-2009; Ord. No. 17270, § 1, 1-26-2010; Ord. No. 17570, § 1, 5-24-2011; Ord. No. 19327, § 27, 4-26-2022)
